properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): add_change_event's `undated` note is decided by `req.detected_at.is_none()` — the CALL — so every revise that omits a date the stored node already holds is told it is undated; present in every release from v0.59.0 (#472) through 0.72.0 and current source, and NOT fixed by #604, which was a design record only
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL on the dev_storyflow field report (art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-27), triaged 2026-09-28.

① OBSERVED, verbatim, twice by the reporter: 2026-09-23 — "revising an existing ChangeEvent with only `summary` (to add the deploy) got back an `undated` note — 'This ChangeEvent carries no `detected_at`' — though the event was created with `detected_at: 2026-09-23` a few calls earlier". 2026-09-25 — "revising a ChangeEvent (same id, `summary` only) returned an `undated` note saying the event 'carries no `detected_at`'. The very same reply echoed `detected_at: "2026-09-25"` in the stored properties." Expected: no note, because the stored (and echoed) node is dated. NOT affected: a genuinely undated create still gets the note, correctly.

② PRECEDENT: fact:revising-a-dated-change-event-warns-it-is-undated-2026-09-27 recorded the same observation on 0.72.0 in flo2's design, explicitly without a cause. reflow2 PR #604 (29bbbd9) is the commit that recorded that fact: it changed only docs/design/reflow2.json and NO source, so it fixed nothing. The note itself came from #472 (90e7610, 2026-09-10, first in v0.59.0), recorded as chg:an-undated-change-event-says-so.

③ CANDIDATES. (a) The note reads the request, not the stored node (reporter's reading). (b) The revise really dropped `detected_at` and the note is right. (c) The observation is stale: an older storyflow binary, since fixed (the #604 hypothesis). (d) Not in the handler: the core write (add_change_event_record) replaces instead of merging, so the date is gone and the echo was misleading.

④ DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT: on a scratch store, create a dated event, revise with `summary` only, then read BOTH the reply and get_node. (a) predicts note present AND date stored; (b) and (d) predict the date absent from get_node; (c) predicts no note on 0.72.0.

⑤ RESULT (reflow2-mcp 0.72.0, one-shot `--call add_change_event`): create {id chg:x, change_type defect_fix, summary, detected_at "2026-09-25"} → no `undated`. Revise {id chg:x, summary "first, and the deploy"} → reply carries `undated` ("This ChangeEvent carries no `detected_at`, so nothing can place it in time…") AND reply event.properties.detected_at = "2026-09-25"; get_node afterwards: detected_at "2026-09-25", summary updated. Control: a create with no date → `undated`, correctly. So (b), (c), (d) are refuted and (a) holds. The source agrees: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/temporal_tools.rs, add_change_event, `if req.detected_at.is_none() { out["undated"] = … }`, and `git diff v0.72.0 HEAD` shows no change to that file, so current source behaves the same (read, not run).

⑥ CLASS: this is not a lone slip. It is one of four ways a revise-capable handler computes from the call instead of the node after the merge — see fact:root-cause-the-revise-contract-is-implemented-per-handler-and-guarded-by-instances-2026-09-28. A fix to this one note would not have stopped the record_finding fact_type reset (09-25) or the add_verification refusal (09-27).

⑦ WHAT A PINNING TEST WOULD ASSERT (not written; out of scope for this triage): for the instance, revise a dated ChangeEvent without `detected_at` → no `undated` key; revise an UNDATED one without it → the note still fires. For the class, the table-driven test named in the class finding.

PROPOSED FIX, the reporter's own "Opportunity" (09-23): compute the note from the node after the merge (the `event` already in hand), not from `req`. It is also brainstormed at surface scope as dec:idea-revise-notes-guards-and-defaults-read-the-merged-node.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: which binary storyflow ran on 09-23 and 09-25. The report does not say. It does not matter: the note exists from v0.59.0, and no release up to 0.72.0 changes it, so every version that could have produced the note has the defect. Current source was read and diffed, not built.

REPORTER'S CONCLUSIONS: "The note appears to check the call's arguments, not the stored node" — CONFIRMED by measurement and source. "…or, worse, concludes the earlier write lost it" — the write did NOT lose it (get_node shows the date), so only the note is wrong. The triage prompt's hypothesis that #604 fixed it — OVERTURNED: #604 recorded the defect and did not fix it.

CLOSED 2026-09-29: fixed by reflow2 PR #624 (squash 8588b7a). The undated note is computed from the merged node, pinned by a_revise_keeps_what_it_was_not_passed.rs. Its change record, chg:a-revise-keeps-what-it-was-not-passed (which INVALIDATES this fact in the committed design), is not in this live store. The live server still runs 0.74.0 until a cut and rebuild.
